mainEntity.name: Can my cottage sauna be wood-burning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, on our larger saunas and barrels, which leave room for a wood stove's clearances. Check your insurer's requirements first.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a cottage sauna?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessory building over 10 m² typically needs a building permit, shoreline and zoning setbacks apply, and electric saunas need an ESA permit. We check your property before you order.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in Haliburton?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including Haliburton. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
